description: Check one construct's standing record on the 402 Open Book. FREE within your wallet's 100/day allowance (pass caller); otherwise $0.01 USDC on Solana — the payment buys one check of one key/identity, returned as a signed verdict with the record's as-of time. It does not include identity verification and is not a guarantee of future behaviour.

caller.description: Your wallet — keys the 100/day free allowance.

liveness_challenge_id.description: Optional liveness challenge id from reputation liveness challenge (POST /toll/reputation/liveness/challenge).

liveness_signature.description: Optional ed25519 signature from the subject key over the liveness answer.

subject.description: Solana base58 pubkey of the key/identity to check.

name: reputation_check
